title: Revenue Management Parameters for Rent Changes on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
The rent-change figures of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement are set per space class as follows. Month figures are calendar months; day figures are calendar days; percentages are fractions of the current monthly rent unless stated otherwise in the column.

### Increase timing and size

| Space class | First increase notice no sooner than (after start date) | Interval after the last rent change | Standard increase cap | Notice before an increase takes effect | Loyalty tenure | Loyalty increase cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 6 months | 11 months | 12% | 30 days | 36 months | 6% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 9 months | 12 months | 10% | 30 days | 36 months | 5% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 9 months | 12 months | 10% | 30 days | 36 months | 5% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 9 months | 12 months | 9% | 45 days | 36 months | 5% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 9 months | 12 months | 9% | 45 days | 36 months | 5% |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 12 months | 12 months | 8% | 45 days | 24 months | 4% |

### Retention concessions

The retention concession share is the share of a noticed increase that may be given back as a retention concession; the request window is counted in calendar days after the increase notice date; the minimum tenure is counted in calendar months since the start date.

| Space class | Retention concession share of the increase | Concessions per rolling 365 days | Request window | Minimum tenure for a concession |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 50% | 1 | 30 days | 12 months |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 50% | 1 | 30 days | 12 months |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 50% | 1 | 30 days | 12 months |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 50% | 1 | 45 days | 12 months |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 50% | 1 | 45 days | 12 months |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 50% | 1 | 45 days | 6 months |

### Standing settings (every class)

| Setting | Every space class |
|---|---|
| An increased rent may never exceed the space's posted street rate on the notice date | Yes |
| An increase notice that breaks the increase rules is rescinded in full | Yes |
| Rent stays unchanged while a prepaid rent plan covers the agreement | Yes |

Hypothetical reading: on a Bluegate Uncovered Car Space at $150.00 a month, the 12% standard cap allows at most $18.00 of increase; at 36 months of tenure or more the 6% loyalty cap allows at most $9.00 instead.
